name: Dropshipping Video Prompt Generator
tagline: I spent a lot of time testing dropshipping products before I built this, and product videos almost always beat static images
description: I spent a lot of time testing dropshipping products before I built this, and product videos almost always beat static images. The problem was that most of my AI videos came out terrible. I kept blaming the model and switching tools, but after making hundreds of them I realized the model was not the issue. The prompt was. So I built this, and I trained it on more than 20 hours of transcripts from creators who actually know how to write AI video prompts. It does one thing well. It writes the promp
